tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe demonstrates a substantial s_grad effect, but the other inputs and horizon remain fixed. A fine trajectory batch is the remaining useful measurement to distinguish candidate two-hop dynamics before fitting and confirming a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth empirical model from the seven rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share u_past, x_now, mem_conv, and H, so their effects cannot be identified; fresh confirmation may vary these inputs.
It is not relevant to resolving the input-response ambiguity and is explicitly discouraged.
The observations are smooth and consistent with stationary dynamics; no chaotic sign oscillation or refutation is present.
